items.problem: Retained classic BackgroundTaskBuilder code + missing <Extension Category="windows.backgroundTasks"> in the build manifest → Register() throws, dead control, 6x partial (score 50).
items.evidence: score notes discrepancies.json D1; app/BackgroundTask/Package.appxmanifest has no <Extensions>; SampleConfiguration.cs calls builder.Register().
items.root_cause: Skill treats background tasks as API-only and never states the manifest extension is a runtime prerequisite; no validator check enforces it.
items.change: Added section 5c to Validate-UwpMigration.ps1: if migrated *.cs uses the classic model (Windows.ApplicationModel.Background + TaskEntryPoint/new BackgroundTaskBuilder + .Register()) and the build Package.appxmanifest has no windows.backgroundTasks <Extension>, emit [FAIL] with a fix hint. Un-ignorable — blocks 'done' until fixed.
items.expected_effect: On re-run the validator FAILs until the extension is added; agent adds it; Register() succeeds; scenarios go partial->pass.
items.falsifiable_check: Running Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 on the current (broken) app prints '[FAIL] ... no <Extension Category="windows.backgroundTasks">' (verified via detection snippet: bgFiles=1, manifest match=False => FAIL=True). After adding the extension it prints [PASS].

items.problem: Skill never documents that retaining the classic background-task model requires the windows.backgroundTasks manifest extension + try/catch around Register().
items.evidence: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Background Tasks' only said 'use WinAppSDK BackgroundTaskBuilder or Task Scheduler'.
items.change: Expanded the 'Background Tasks' pattern: added the two runtime prerequisites (manifest <Extension> per TaskEntryPoint with an XML example; try/catch to avoid a silent dead control).
items.expected_effect: Agent that reads the pattern carries the extension over and guards Register().

items.problem: The general rule 'carry over ALL UWP <Extensions>' was a buried parenthetical; the checklist had no explicit step, so extensions (backgroundTasks/protocol/fileTypeAssociation/appService/shareTarget) get dropped.
items.change: Added checklist item 5 'Carry over every UWP <Extension>' with a category->feature table and a note that omission fails at runtime (dead control), not build.
items.expected_effect: Agents merge manifest extensions for protocol/file/appService/shareTarget/backgroundTasks apps generally.
items.falsifiable_check: Grep the manifest checklist contains a 'windows.protocol'/'windows.fileTypeAssociation' extension table row.
